name: smwmusic-sonic-cd-jp-eu-mining-paradise-quartz-quadrant-jp-mix-remix
title: Sonic CD (JP/EU) - Mining Paradise ~ Quartz Quadrant 'JP Mix' (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Quartz Quadrant JP from Sonic CD. Good freaking God is this song fantastic :DDDD. I stand by this (and every other time variation of the JP theme) being the best song in the entire game. Catchy melodies, fantastic instrumentation, a wonderful chord to support the song in the 2nd half, and that killer brass.

Sonic CD easily in my top 10 Sonic OSTs. It's a pure representation of 90s music, and I love it!!!

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" is disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. E / A Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F / A# Minor (Past Pitch)
